ambiguity.detail: The flash-forward explosion drops the viewer into chaos with zero context on who caused it.
Catherine and Rupert's past as 'ignored cousins' is hinted at but lacks background.

verdict.hook_line: Ear-splitting detonation, shattering stone, wood splintering violently into kindling, followed by terrified screams of the congregation.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: And you look better in silk than you ever did as an ignored cousin.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: An ambitious couple is seizing power through a high-society wedding, foreshadowed by an explosion.
verdict.why_it_works: The explosive cold open instantly grabs attention before flashing back to the arrogant bride and groom.
